name: HPM6750EVKMINI
description: Compact evaluation board for the dual-core 816 MHz RISC-V HPM6750 with on-board FT2232 debugger, Ethernet, USB, SDIO, QSPI flash and external RAM; about 298 RMB in China.
notes: Price is about 298 RMB converted (2022 listing); availability outside China is limited and orders go through HPMicro or Chinese distributors. HPM6750 has no internal flash: the board carries 8 MB QSPI flash and external DRAM (psramMB = 0 here because the DRAM size was not verified).

Not listed on HPMicro's current HPM6700 page (it shows the larger HPM6750EVK2, 146 x 102 mm), so the mini may be superseded; the EVKMINI is still in the RT-Thread BSP. Peripheral list (USB, Ethernet, QSPI, SDIO) is from the RT-Thread README. USB connector type, SD slot, size and GPIO count were not verified.
